This isn't just a dress—it's a wearable time-travel device for those who've ever had to sprint out of a party like their life depended on it. Perfect for Cinderella cosplayers who want to be prepared in case their fairy godmother gets a little *too* into the after-party.

title: Backpack AC: For When Fans Aren’t Enough
tagline: You know that one friend who insists on hiking in the middle of July? The one who turns every outing into a survival challenge? This is their spirit animal—a backpack with its own air conditioning unit. Perfect for when you’re waiting in line at a festival and the guy behind you won’t stop complaining about the heat. Just turn it on and watch his jealousy boil over.

title: Neon Nightmare Armor
tagline: For when your dystopian LARP group gets invited to a corporate retreat. This isn’t just a costume—it’s a statement. Perfect for the cyberpunk who wants to look like they’ve been in a fistfight with a vending machine, then immediately board a hovercraft to a board meeting. Just don’t blame us if HR asks questions.

title: Disco Fairy Armor
tagline: For when your cat’s birthday party clashes with your neighbor’s backyard rave. This dress is basically a wearable piñata—sparkles guaranteed to outshine both the birthday candles and your questionable life choices. Bonus: The rainbow sequins double as a distraction if you need to make a quick exit.

title: Stealthy Seafaring Feline
tagline: For when your 'weekend yacht' needs to double as a covert ops vessel. Perfect for the eccentric billionaire who wants to smuggle their vintage wine collection past customs—or just impress their cat by pretending the boat is named after them. Comes with all the tactical bells and whistles, because why settle for a regular speedboat when you can have a catamaran that could probably outrun the IRS?

title: Zombie Mobile
tagline: Because walking is overrated, this vehicle is perfect for when you need to escape a zombie horde while also transporting your extensive collection of vintage typewriters.

title: Timey-Wimey Trinket Vault
tagline: For the Whovian who insists their jewelry collection needs a police box makeover. Perfect for storing your 'borrowed' alien artifacts or hiding your sonic screwdriver from the TARDIS's nosy maintenance crew. Just don't blame us if it starts humming and vanishing at random.

title: Spin Cycle Mansion
tagline: Because who needs a normal view, for $5.3 million, you can wake up to a different wall every morning, literally, with this rotating house, perfect for when you want to confuse your morning coffee routine.

title: Rapunzel's Pirate Lair
tagline: For the kid who's given up on social skills, this $48,000 treehouse is perfect. Imagine explaining to therapists why your 8-year-old has a pirate-themed, hair-growing, lofty abode in the backyard.

title: Your New Roommate: 7' Tall
tagline: For when your landlord insists on 'no pets' but says nothing about a 7-foot-tall, 300-pound metal companion. Perfect for those nights when you want to intimidate your Tinder date into thinking you're a tech billionaire. Just don't ask it to do the dishes—it's not that kind of robot.

title: Ping Pong in Mid Air
tagline: Because your garage needed a centerpiece, this floating ping pong table is perfect for that one dinner party where you serve pizza on the ceiling fan and call it 'immersive dining'.

title: Float Like a Boss (Scorpion Zero)
tagline: Because your coding sessions were missing a dash of astronaut training, this zero-gravity workstation has you covered. Imagine debugging while upside down, it's like your brain needed that extra challenge.

title: Ninja Wheels for the Paranoid
tagline: Because nothing says 'I'm not up to anything suspicious' like silently zooming past security guards at 20 mph. Perfect for that time you need to deliver a very important, very illegal-looking package while maintaining plausible deniability. Just don't forget to wear your 'I'm just a harmless bike messenger' face.

title: Swear Like a Tarantino
tagline: For when your morning coffee isn't enough to wake up the neighbors. These action figures let you channel your inner Jules Winnfield, complete with profanity-laced monologues. Perfect for that 'I just found out my cat is actually a demon' moment. Comes with a tiny gun for added authenticity.

title: Land Yacht, Sea Cow?
tagline: Five million to announce, "I'm overcompensating, but *fast*." Perfect for when you absolutely MUST arrive at the marina before your therapist does, and need to do so in something louder than their sailboat. Just try not to think about the gas bill.

title: Pool Table for Bond Villains
tagline: When your basement lair needs more than just a dartboard. This crystal pool table is perfect for plotting world domination while your henchmen argue over who gets to break. Just don't blame us if your evil plans get sidetracked by a heated game of eight-ball.

title: Jacket of Desperate Affection
tagline: For when you're craving human touch but your cat is busy, this jacket provides a suffocating hug on demand, because who needs personal space?

title: Lambo Goes Mud Wrestling
tagline: Because your safari vacation needs a $2 million Italian supercar that can handle dirt roads and questionable life choices.

title: Blink and You're Dead
tagline: Perfect for that friend who insists on hosting a 'Silent Party'—just make sure they don't turn their back. Or, you know, ever look away. Also doubles as a conversation killer at awkward family gatherings. Just don't forget to blink.
